    • mapException

      public SubstrateSdkException mapException(Throwable t)
      Description copied from interface: SdkService
      Maps a provider-specific Throwable to a fully-built SubstrateSdkException the caller can throw directly. The returned exception carries both the typed mapping (e.g. ResourceNotFoundException for HTTP 404) and an authoritative retryable flag derived from the native cloud SDK signal (e.g. AWS throttling, GCP ApiException.isRetryable(), status codes), or the type's default retryability when the SDK exposes no native signal.

      Callers throw the result; they do not inspect or transform it further: 

      
 try {
   ...
 } catch (Throwable t) {
   throw provider.mapException(t);
 }

      Implementation contract: implementations should compute a typed exception class (typically via their per-service ErrorCodeMapping) and a retryable hint, then return ExceptionHandler.build(exceptionClass, t, retryableHint). Implementations do not need to short-circuit when t is already a SubstrateSdkException: ExceptionHandler.build preserves an already-mapped exception's concrete subtype and retryable flag.

      Parameters:
      t - the original throwable from the provider SDK
      Returns:
      a built SubstrateSdkException ready to throw

    • doListBlobVersions

      protected Iterator<BlobMetadata> doListBlobVersions(ListBlobVersionsRequest request)
      Lists every version of an exact key on a single newest-first timeline. By default only content versions are returned and no archivedAt supersession instant is derived, matching the backward-compatible contract. When includeArchived is set the timeline also includes delete markers and each entry reports the cloud-neutral archivedAt it stopped being current, which may be the creation time of a superseding delete marker.
      Overrides:

    • doGetBucketVersioning

      protected BucketVersioningConfiguration doGetBucketVersioning()
      Description copied from class: AbstractBlobStore
      Provider hook for AbstractBlobStore.getBucketVersioning().

      Default implementation throws UnsupportedOperationException; providers opt in by overriding this method. This is intentionally non-abstract (unlike AbstractBlobStore.doDoesBucketExist()) because not every substrate supports bucket-level versioning configuration. An opt-in default avoids forcing those providers to implement a stub that merely throws, while still requiring a deliberate decision from any new provider that does support the feature.

      Error contract: When the bucket does not exist, implementations may propagate the substrate's native exception. The central exception mapper will normalize these to the appropriate MultiCloudJ exception type for callers.

      Overrides:
      doGetBucketVersioning in class AbstractBlobStore

    • getObjectLock

      public ObjectLockInfo getObjectLock(String key, String versionId)
      Description copied from interface: BlobStore
      Gets object lock configuration for a blob.

      Retention and legal hold are independent sub-resources on an object version; a version may have neither, only a legal hold, only retention, or both. Implementations return null only when the object has neither. If either is present the result is non-null: a legal-hold-only object surfaces with legalHold=true and null mode / retainUntilDate, and a retention-only object surfaces with legalHold=false and non-null mode / date.

      Parameters:
      key - Object key
      versionId - Optional version ID. For versioned buckets, null means latest version.
      Returns:
      ObjectLockInfo describing the object's lock state, or null if the object has neither retention nor legal hold configured

    • updateObjectRetention

      public void updateObjectRetention(String key, String versionId, Instant retainUntilDate)
      Description copied from class: AbstractBlobStore
      Updates object retention date, preserving the object's current retention mode.

      Deprecated. Use BlobStore.updateObjectRetention(String, String, ObjectRetentionConfig) which can set the mode and request a governance bypass. This method delegates to the new overload with mode=null (preserve current) and bypassGovernanceRetention=false.

      Existing non-uniform behavior: Today's AWS implementation throws FailedPreconditionException for any update on a COMPLIANCE-mode object — even extension. GCP allows extension on LOCKED. The new overload introduces a uniform rules table; this deprecated method preserves each provider's existing semantics.

      Deprecated path: delegates to AbstractBlobStore.updateObjectRetention(String, String, ObjectRetentionConfig) with mode=null (preserve current mode) and bypassGovernanceRetention=false. This delegation gives every provider a single retention- update code path and prevents AWS/GCP behavior from drifting.

      Note: the historical AWS implementation rejected ANY update on COMPLIANCE objects (including extension), while GCP allows extending LOCKED. Each provider's existing override of this deprecated method takes precedence over this delegate, preserving its legacy semantics; the new overload introduces a uniform rules table across providers.

      Specified by:
      updateObjectRetention in interface BlobStore
      Overrides:
      updateObjectRetention in class AbstractBlobStore
      Parameters:
      key - Object key
      versionId - Optional version ID. For versioned buckets, null means latest version.
      retainUntilDate - New retention expiration date

    • doUpdateObjectRetention

      protected void doUpdateObjectRetention(String key, String versionId, ObjectRetentionConfig config)
      Description copied from class: AbstractBlobStore
      Provider hook for AbstractBlobStore.updateObjectRetention(String, String, ObjectRetentionConfig).

      State-dependent validation (no-current-retention rejection, mode-transition rules, shorten-with-bypass rules) lives here per design §E so all providers surface uniform exception types and messages. Stateless validation has already been performed by the template before this hook is invoked.

      Default implementation throws UnsupportedOperationException — provider implementations that do not support per-object retention (e.g. Alibaba OSS) inherit this behavior without further work.

      Overrides:
      doUpdateObjectRetention in class AbstractBlobStore
